summary: End-to-end backend + UI smoke test for CineReel AI. 30/31 backend pytest cases passing. Confirmed signup → dashboard → new project → project-detail flow works end-to-end. Two real backend issues found: (1) ElevenLabs TTS fails because the provided ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is a FREE-tier key, the API returns 402 'paid_plan_required: Free users cannot use library voices via the API.' (2) Gemini scene-image generation is broken: model 'gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview' returns 404 NotFound from Google ('not found for API version v1beta'). The endpoint correctly returns a warning instead of 500, but the actual feature does not work. Also flagged: /ai endpoints can return raw 500 when emergentintegrations raises ChatError (e.g. budget exceeded) — they should wrap and return 502 like /ai/tts does.

critical.issue: Returns 502 because ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is a free-tier key. ElevenLabs API responds 402 paid_plan_required: 'Free users cannot use library voices via the API. Please upgrade your subscription to use this voice.' Either upgrade key, or supply user-cloned/custom voice IDs.

Underlying Gemini model 'gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview' returns 404 NotFound ('not supported for generateContent'). Image generation does not actually work — every call returns image_url=null with warning. Update model name (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' / 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp-image-generation') in /app/backend/ai_services.py.

minor.issue: Returned 500 once (Emergent LLM budget exceeded - 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.019116, Max budget: 0.001'). Endpoint should catch emergentintegrations.llm.chat.ChatError and return 502 like /ai/tts does. Same applies to /ai/script, /ai/hooks, /ai/ad-ideas which currently propagate as 500.
Voices use field 'id' (not 'voice_id' as some docs/tests assumed). Confirm field name in API contract; frontend uses voice.id correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar nav links DO NOT have the data-testid attributes referenced in the review_request (sidebar-projects, sidebar-script, sidebar-voice, sidebar-scene, sidebar-templates, sidebar-brand-kit, sidebar-assets, sidebar-credits, sidebar-settings). All returned not-found in DOM. Add data-testid to each sidebar <Link> for automated testing.

React hydration warning: <span> placed inside <option> (the static-import/var instrumentation wraps the option text in a span, which is invalid HTML). Console error logged on every project detail load.

integration_issues.issue: Will fail with 502 in UI because backend TTS fails (free-tier ElevenLabs key)
Will produce scene tiles with null image_url (placeholders only) because Gemini image model is 404

Fix Gemini image model name in /app/backend/ai_services.py — 'gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview' no longer exists; try 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' or the current Nano Banana model id
Wrap LlmChat.send_message calls in try/except (ChatError) for /ai/script, /ai/hooks, /ai/ctas, /ai/ad-ideas — return 502 with friendly message instead of raw 500 (refund credits on failure)

Add data-testid attributes to sidebar links in /app/frontend/src/pages/DashboardLayout.jsx (sidebar-projects, sidebar-script, sidebar-voice, sidebar-scene, sidebar-templates, sidebar-brand-kit, sidebar-assets, sidebar-credits, sidebar-settings)
Fix hydration error in voice-select <option> rendering in ProjectDetail.jsx (remove dynamic span wrapper inside option text, or render plain string)
critical_code_review_comments: _charge_credits deducts credits BEFORE the AI call. If the AI call throws, the user is charged but gets nothing. Add try/except in /ai/* handlers that refunds on failure.
Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD — production users with corporate emails will work, but be aware that test domains fail.
Frontend /signup heading still says 'Sign in to direct your next viral reel.' — should say 'Sign up' or 'Create your account' to match the active tab.
/api/catalog/assets returns a dict ({images, music, icons, stickers}) while other catalogs return lists. Inconsistent shape — consider normalising or documenting clearly.
Default admin password 'admin12345' is committed in code — fine for MVP but flag for production hardening.

rca of the issue: TTS 502: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env (6e4126a0...) is a free-tier key. Backend log shows: status_code: 402, body: {'detail': {'type': 'payment_required', 'code': 'paid_plan_required', 'message': 'Free users cannot use library voices via the API. Please upgrade your subscription to use this voice.'}}. Reproduction: POST /api/ai/tts with any library voice_id (e.g. 9BWtsMINqrJLrRacOk9x Aria). Mitigation: (a) upgrade ElevenLabs plan, or (b) clone all voices into the account's library via the ElevenLabs dashboard so they're no longer 'library voices' from the free-tier API's perspective, or (c) accept a user-supplied custom voice_id. Scene image 404: Google deprecated 'gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview'. Update ai_services.generate_scene_image to use the current image-capable Gemini model identifier (check https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models for current names).
